name: paper-search
description: Paper Search is a free academic literature search expert built on OpenAlex with more than 250 million works, and it degrades automatically to Semantic Scholar whenever OpenAlex returns a rate limit. It searches papers by keyword with relevance, citation or date sorting, or looks up a single paper by DOI or OpenAlex ID to return authors, abstract, concepts, open-access PDF links and related works. It needs no API key and no registration, supports chained citation exploration, and always reports which backend served the result so that citations stay traceable and verifiable.

displayDescription.en: A free academic literature search expert powered by OpenAlex with automatic Semantic Scholar fallback. It finds papers by keyword or looks up a single work by DOI, returning authors, citation counts, abstracts and open-access links, with no API key or registration required.
displayDescription.zh: 免费检索二点五亿篇学术文献，按关键词找论文、按DOI查单篇详情，给出作者年份被引与开放获取链接。
